decisions_taken.why: mandatory bug fix; phase and cosine selectivity are scale-invariant, while dnb08 is non-monotone and B costs substantially more
declare the third metric before the full run; avoid manufacturing a null after seeing the 3x run-2 difference
written after the pre-grid diagnostic and before the full grid

reference_departures.departure: core readout uses a 30 s window instead of Shiu's 1 s t_run
reference_departures.reason: rates converge in 1 s but phase at 1.5 Hz needs at least 10 analysed cycles

reference_departures.departure: named VNC descending sets and 260 motor outputs instead of hard-coded sugar IDs to MN9
reference_departures.reason: port labeled-line question into frozen VNC hexapod

reference_departures.departure: silence named neuron types and published coordination types
reference_departures.reason: test type-level necessity in the available VNC index

reference_departures.departure: rewired and random graph controls plus amplitude matching
reference_departures.reason: connectome-specificity null required by this campaign

reference_departures.departure: body trace is 8 s and descriptive only
reference_departures.reason: the labeled motor readouts, not body distance, decide the numerical result

self_interrogation.b: 0.0; no trainable parameter range touched by any arm
self_interrogation.c: No outcome-selected constant; 150 Hz primary was declared from Shiu's default before rollout, and all four rates are reported
self_interrogation.g: rewired=reservoir_3way.degree_preserving_rewire (12 graph seeds); random=reservoir_3way.randomize_weights (12 graph seeds); both preserve row/column degree and signed weight multiset as applicable
self_interrogation.h: The connectome is not credited with body distance; only named motor rate, selectivity, and phase readouts decide the numerical result.

1.note: Strategy A rate scaling is unconditional; deficit unit check passed

2.note: dnb08 diagnostic verdict logged before grid

4.note: run-2 spectrum carried forward and v3 control extension recorded

5.note: 400 declared grid conditions have terminal states

6.note: post-match motor_hz and frac_active ratios recorded; unmatchable cells terminal, active fraction report-only

7.note: real and unscaled control rate tables reported; Strategy A caveat attached

8.note: 20 antagonist cells with phase, concentration, SD, and in-band power

10.note: declared selectivity pairs and rates reported

13.note: A/B/C/D ablation ladder measured; phase degeneracy stated

18.note: three readout artifact MD5 digests distinct

19.note: numeric verdict recorded with owner approval required

20.note: orchestrator verifies pod termination after artifact pull

matching_audit_summary.cross_arm_rate_caveat: Strategy A rescales controls for the matched readout; compare unscaled control rates, not matched cross-arm rates.

full.readout: rate/selectivity; raw_rate_table is the unscaled control table

constant_connectome.definition: each real history replaced by its temporal mean
constant_connectome.readout: rate/selectivity; raw_rate_table is the unscaled control table

time_shuffled.definition: each real history time-permuted with declared seed
time_shuffled.readout: rate/selectivity; raw_rate_table is the unscaled control table

drive_only.definition: independent Poisson motor readout without connectome
drive_only.readout: rate/selectivity; raw_rate_table is the unscaled control table
